content.text: The Focused Ultrasound Examination has become increasingly recognised as a safe and valuable diagnostic tool for the bedside assessment of critically ill patients. CIME in collaboration with Department of Anaesthesiology organised the 3rd Critical Care Focused Ultrasound Workshop. The course aimed at providing information to physicians working in critical care areas including emergency room about this important tool that actually can help them in making rapid fact-based decisions thus improving the quality of care.

The course ensured that participants acquire the skills and knowledge needed to perform this procedure effectively. Participants were actively engaged with realistic clinical scenarios and experienced hands-on practice with high-fidelity ultrasound simulators (Vimedix and SonoSim).
